messages:
anas: hi! first week here :wave: got my laptop + monitor but the USB-A dongle (for the old keyboard) wasn't in the box. webcam image is also really grainy on video calls. who do i ping for replacements and quick camera troubleshooting?
shipping-bot: package PKG-8842 delivered to 5th floor bench 12 at 09:12. items: MacBook Pro, ViewSonic 24, SwitchMount, USB-C dock. missing: USB-A dongle.
jamal_it: hey Anas, welcome! sorry about that. i can drop a USB-A dongle by your desk today. can you confirm the keyboard model and whether the webcam is external or the laptop built-in?
anas: keyboard is Logitech K380 (bluetooth but we use the wired dongle for workstations). webcam is the built-in Mac camera but image is fuzzy even on native FaceTime.
olga: quick remote check: open Terminal and run `system_profiler SPCameraDataType` and paste output? also check in FaceTime -> Video -> Camera shows 'FaceTime HD Camera (Built-in)'.
anas: output: "Camera: FaceTime HD Camera (Built-in)
Model ID: UVC Camera Vendor
Device ID: 0x1234
Connection: Built-in
Status: Active". it shows active but picture looks like low light even with desk lamp on.
jamal_it: could be camera permissions or an exposure setting bug on macOS 13.6. try toggling the camera privacy: System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Camera: toggle off then on for FaceTime/Zoom. also open QuickTime Player -> New Movie Recording and test.
anas: toggled, quicktime also fuzzy. seems like software.
olga: two possibilities: (1) the camera firmware needs a reset via SMC/NVRAM, or (2) there's a hardware issue from shipping (loose connection). can you try resetting NVRAM: shutdown, power on and immediately hold Option+Cmd+P+R for 20s. note: this will reset some settings.
anas: done reset, restarted. camera still grainy.
jamal_it: ok i'll raise an IT ticket and schedule a quick in-person check. also i can drop a USB-A dongle and a cheap external USB webcam (Logitech C920) for now.
it-bot: ticket IT-6742 created and assigned to jamal_it. ETA onsite check today between 3-5pm.
shipping-bot: spare USB-A dongle dispatched from IT locker -> ETA 45m. webcam loaner available at IT desk.
jamal_it: when i come by we'll also swap the USB-C dock to rule out any firmware issues that affect the internal camera power rail. if the external webcam is fine, we'll RMA the laptop.
anas: thanks so much! appreciate the fast response.
jamal_it: no prob. ping here if anything changes. :thumbsup:
anas: quick follow-up after jamal stopped by: swapped dock and loaner webcam -> loaner good, dock swap didn't change built-in camera. plugged in the replacement USB-A dongle, keyboard works. looks like laptop camera is hardware; cool to RMA. thanks everyone! :tada:
